text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=latency-prod severity=critical — p99 > 1200ms (rolling 5m). Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-3302009876 :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: acked oncall. I'm on it, checking dashboards now.
Aaron Chen: looking at autoscaler and node metrics, any regional skew?
Priya Singh: us-west-2 shows request rate +2.8x, queue depth at batcher +310%, KV cache miss rate jumped to 72% — possible hotkey or eviction cascade.
Aaron Chen: metrics: p95=420ms, p99=1300ms, worker CPU normal, GPU util steady. No spike in errors. Could be tail amplification from cache churn.
Maya Patel: running quick probe: `curl -sS https://ops-metrics/api/latency?range=5m | jq .` shows spike at 2026-03-18T14:02Z.
Ben Lowe: starting diversion to reserved inference pool (dedicated capacity) and initiating model-variant fallback (seq_len_small). Routing change in progress.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalated to eng-sre after 2m without stable ack escalate.
CS-bot: Received inbound ticket from AcmeCorp: "Embeddings slow / intermittent 503s since 14:02 UTC" — marking customer-impact=yes.
Priya Singh: can we temporarily throttle anonymous queries and enable prefix caching? Prefix cache TTL currently 0 for many routes.
Ben Lowe: applied temporary rate-limit: `rlimit set --service embeddings --limit 250rps` and bumped prefix cache TTL to 60s for embeddings route. Also triggered hotkey eviction policy to release noisy keys.
Maya Patel: after routing + rate-limit, p99 trending down to ~800ms at 14:07 UTC. Monitoring for stabilization.
Aaron Chen: autoscaler backoff prevented extra pods coming up earlier — I adjusted HPA minReplicas from 8->12 to absorb burst.
Priya Singh: confirming CS update sent to AcmeCorp: "We observed a latency surge linked to cache churn; mitigation in progress."
Ben Lowe: rolling canary fallback to eu-west pool as additional capacity, configured automatic fallback if p99 > 900ms persists.
incident-bot: Alert status: ongoing -> acknowledging mitigation actions.
Maya Patel: p99 now 520ms at 14:12 UTC, queue depth normalizing. I'm going to keep the diversion and rate limits for 15m then start gradual rollback if stable.
Priya Singh: assigning postmortem owner: Priya Singh. Initial hypothesis: transient KV cache thrash (hotkey + eviction) amplified by conservative autoscaler settings and a burst of unauthenticated traffic.
Aaron Chen: next actions: capture KV eviction traces, collect batcher latency traces, and check autoscaler cooldown config.
CS-bot: Notified AcmeCorp support thread with status update and ETA.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. If no regressions by 14:30 UTC I'll close the incident and file an incident note.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (no active triggers) at 3302010176.
Maya Patel: closing thread — will publish timeline + mitigation steps in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
